start: Signed in as the owner; gym online; the gym has saved workout plans; member page of a member with none

steps.action: In the "Workout plans" card read the line, then tap "Send a plan"
user_sees: "No workout plan sent yet. They see one in the MettleUp app after one check-in at the gym."
Sheet titled "Send a plan to <member name>"
A list "Your gym’s plans", each row ending in "Send"
Below: "Or make one for them" with "Start from a ready plan" and "Make a new plan"
must_not: Plans of another gym in the list

steps.action: Tap one plan
user_sees: That row reads "Sending…"; the other rows cannot be tapped
Sheet closes
A bar "“<plan>” sent to <member name>." with Undo, for about 8 seconds
The plan name now shows in the Workout plans card
must_not: The plan sent twice
Another desk's change to the plan lost by this save
Other members taken off the plan

start: Signed in as the owner; "Send a plan" sheet open

steps.action: Tap "Start from a ready plan"
user_sees: Title changes to "Start from a ready plan"
A list of ready plans ("Beginner to advanced, filled in for you")
Button "‹ Back"
must_not: The sheet closing by itself

steps.action: Pick a ready plan
user_sees: The plan builder opens with this member already ticked
must_not: The builder opening with no member ticked
The plan saved before the person presses save

steps.action: Save in the builder
user_sees: Toast "“<plan>” sent to <member name>."
must_not: "“<plan>” saved." while this member was ticked

start: Signed in as the owner; "Send a plan" sheet open; the gym has no plans of its own

steps.action: Read the sheet, tap "Make a new plan"
user_sees: No "Your gym’s plans" list; the heading reads "Make one for them"
The builder opens empty ("Pick every exercise yourself") with this member ticked
must_not: An empty "Your gym’s plans" heading

steps.action: Untick the member in the builder and save
user_sees: Toast "“<plan>” saved." (not "sent")
must_not: A toast saying it was sent to the member

start: Signed in as the owner; member who already gets one of the gym's plans

steps.action: Tap "Send a plan"
user_sees: That plan's row carries "Already sent" and cannot be tapped
must_not: The same plan sent a second time

steps.action: Send another plan while a second device has just changed that plan
user_sees: A red line in the sheet saying someone else changed this plan; nothing is sent
must_not: The other device's change overwritten

steps.action: Turn the internet off
user_sees: "Send a plan" is greyed and says it needs internet
must_not: A plan shown as sent that never reached the server

steps.action: Look at a gym that is not online
user_sees: The card reads "No workout plan sent yet." followed by words that the gym is not online yet
must_not: "They see one in the MettleUp app" promised to a gym that is not online

start: Signed in as the owner; a plan was sent one tap ago; the Undo bar is showing

steps.action: Tap Undo on the bar
user_sees: Toast "“<plan>” is no longer sent to <member name>."
The plan leaves the Workout plans card
must_not: The whole plan deleted
Other members taken off it

steps.action: Send it again and wait 8 seconds
user_sees: The bar goes away; the plan stays sent
must_not: The plan taken back when the bar times out

steps.action: Look at a member who gets a plan through their membership plan
user_sees: The plan name followed by " · through their membership plan"
must_not: "Already sent" missing so the plan is sent by name a second time with no word
